title: Blockchain for Supply Chain Tracking PoC
description: Designed a proof-of-concept for a supply chain tracking system using blockchain to ensure transparency and traceability of goods from origin to consumer. Mapped out the architecture and smart contract logic.

title: NFT Minting Platform Prototype
description: Built a web-based dApp to allow users to mint their own NFTs (ERC-721 tokens). Integrated with IPFS for decentralized metadata storage and created a simple frontend for users to upload images and mint tokens.
